ios.desc:
Transform your hair care journey with Fiora, your personal AI-powered hair health analyzer and progress tracker. Get professional-grade analysis and personalized recommendations in seconds.

KEY FEATURES:
• Instant Hair Analysis: Advanced AI technology analyzes your hair's condition
• Comprehensive Scoring: Detailed ratings for moisture, damage, scalp health, breakage, shine, and porosity
• Personalized Recommendations: Get tailored product suggestions and care techniques
• Progress Tracking: Monitor your hair's improvement over time with detailed charts
• Expert Insights: Receive science-backed hair care and lifestyle recommendations
• Secure & Private: Your data is encrypted and stored securely

Perfect for:
• Understanding your hair's unique needs
• Tracking hair treatment progress
• Building an effective hair care routine
• Making informed product choices
• Achieving your hair health goals

Download Fiora today and start your journey to healthier, more beautiful hair!
